title: Bulk reference and chemical potential calculations
action: Perform DFT total-energy calculations for wurtzite GaN (optimise lattice parameters), orthorhombic Ga metal, an isolated N2 molecule, hcp Be metal, and α-Be3N2. Use these to establish the chemical potentials μ_Ga, μ_N, μ_Be and the heats of formation ΔH_f(GaN) and ΔH_f(α-Be3N2). Save the computed total energies and optimised lattice parameters for later steps.
description: Required precursor to defect formation‑energy and structural relaxation steps. The agent must compute the reference energies and lattice constants.

title: Be_Ga defect supercell structural relaxation
action: Construct a 72‑atom hexagonal GaN supercell with a substitutional Be on a Ga site. Relax the structure in the neutral (q=0) and negative (q=−1) charge states using DFT with the optimised lattice parameters from step_0. Save the relaxed atomic coordinates and total energies.
description: Required to obtain the relaxed geometry for bond-length extraction and the total energies needed for formation-energy calculations.

title: Be_Ga bond lengths
action: From the relaxed structures obtained in step_1, extract the four nearest‑neighbour bond lengths (labelled a, b, c, d as in the paper's structural diagram) for each combination of basis treatment (Ga 3d explicit, nlcc approximation) and charge state (0, –1). Output the values as a JSON file.
description: Bond lengths (Å) for the Be_Ga acceptor. Scored by comparison with the paper‑reported Table I values within ±0.02 Å.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: "basis" (list of strings: ["Ga3d","nlcc","nlcc"]), "charge" (list of ints: [0,0,-1]), "N-Be_a" (list of floats, Å), "Be-N_b" (list of floats, Å), "N-Ga_c" (list of floats, Å), "Ga-N_d" (list of floats, Å). Each list length 3.

title: Be_Ga formation energies
action: Using the total energies from step_1 and the reference chemical potentials from step_0, compute the formation energy E_f(0) of neutral Be_Ga under Ga‑rich and N‑rich conditions via the standard defect formation‑energy formula. Output the two values.
description: Formation energy (eV) of neutral Be_Ga; scored against the paper‑reported values (2.45 eV Ga‑rich, 2.03 eV N‑rich) within ±0.1 eV. This step forces correct execution of the reference and relaxation stages.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: "Ga_rich_Ef0" (float, eV), "N_rich_Ef0" (float, eV).

title: Be_Ga local vibrational modes
action: Using the relaxed structure of neutral Be_Ga from step_1, construct the dynamical matrix by finite displacements of the Be atom and its four nearest‑neighbour N atoms. Diagonalise to obtain the four highest A1‑symmetry local vibrational mode frequencies. Output the frequencies.
description: Vibrational frequencies (cm⁻¹) for Be_Ga; scored by comparison with paper‑reported values (e.g., 445, 562, 593, 663 cm⁻¹) within ±15 cm⁻¹ and correct ordering.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: "basis" (string, e.g., "nlcc"), "charge" (int, 0), "frequencies" (list of 4 floats, cm⁻¹).

title: (Be‑Be)_Ga split‑interstitial structural relaxation
action: Construct a 72‑atom GaN supercell containing a split‑interstitial beryllium pair at a Ga site ((Be‑Be)_Ga). Relax the structure in the neutral charge state (q=0) using DFT. Save the relaxed atomic coordinates.
description: Required to obtain the relaxed geometry for the (Be‑Be)_Ga local vibrational mode calculation.

title: (Be‑Be)_Ga local vibrational modes
action: From the relaxed structure of (Be‑Be)_Ga obtained in step_5, compute the dynamical matrix by finite displacements of the two Be atoms and their nearest neighbours. Diagonalise to obtain the three highest local vibrational mode frequencies. Output the frequencies.
description: Vibrational frequencies (cm⁻¹) for (Be‑Be)_Ga; scored by comparison with paper‑reported values (1041, 789, 738 cm⁻¹) within ±15 cm⁻¹ and correct ordering.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: "charge" (int, 0), "frequencies" (list of 3 floats, cm⁻¹).
